name: Mast cells
tissue_context: In the liver, MCs are mainly associated with connective tissue located in the surrounding of the hepatic arteries, veins, and bile ducts.; The localization of MCs in the liver is mostly restricted to portal tracts.; In a normal human liver, MCs are associated with the connective tissue and are mainly found along the portal tracts.
